title: Chatbot
notes: Rebuilt conversations list on ListPage (FilterBar for status/channel, infinite scroll, hover Eye/Close actions, detail navigation, empty state, skeleton, bulk close, full-dataset CSV export). Conversation detail rebuilt on DetailPage with SendMessageDialog (visitor email), Activity tab from message timeline, Hand off dialog, Close, and a Create lead action wired to the previously-orphaned POST /chatbot/conversations/:id/create-lead (navigates to the new lead). Analytics page gated and reads only real ChatbotAnalytics fields — removed the fabricated handoff-reasons/popular-topics charts that had no backing endpoint. Settings page gated, reads/writes real ChatbotConfig, and adds an Install widget tab with a copyable embed snippet built from GET /chatbot/widget.js — removed the fabricated FAQ and business-hours tabs since there is no backing endpoint for them. relationCombobox/phoneInput/addressAutocomplete/currencyInput/datePicker are marked true as not-applicable — this slice has no relation, phone, address, currency, or date fields.
showcaseScript: Hand it off to a human agent
Convert the conversation into a lead
Copy the website widget embed snippet from settings
